description: This file defines the ColumnAndRowAttributes class, which is responsible for parsing and applying column and row attributes (like width, visibility, outline level, etc.) from the XML representation of an Excel sheet within the PhpSpreadsheet library's XLSX reader component.

classes.name: ColumnAndRowAttributes
classes.description: Handles parsing and setting of column and row attributes from the sheet XML in a XLSX file.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worksheet object and optional worksheet XML.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and applies column and row attributes from the worksheet XML, optionally considering a read filter.

methods.name: setColumnAttributes
methods.description: Sets attributes for a specific column based on provided attribute array.

methods.name: setRowAttributes
methods.description: Sets attributes for a specific row based on provided attribute array.

methods.name: isFilteredColumn
methods.description: Checks if a column should be filtered out based on the read filter.

methods.name: readColumnAttributes
methods.description: Reads column attributes from the worksheet XML given a column element.

methods.name: readColumnRangeAttributes
methods.description: Reads attributes for a range of columns from the XML element.

methods.name: isFilteredRow
methods.description: Checks if a row should be filtered out based on the read filter.

methods.name: readRowAttributes
methods.description: Reads row attributes from the worksheet XML.
